name: Gujarat block-print dupatta
about: A lightweight cotton scarf stamped by hand with carved wooden blocks, a craft Gujarat is known for. Ahmedabad's textile trade makes it a natural place to buy one.
tip: Check the material and dyeing method with the staff before you pay.

name: Mata ni Pachedi painting, small
about: A traditional textile painting from Ahmedabad, made on cloth with natural dyes and a devotional theme. It is a local art form tied to the city's craft history.
tip: Learn to tell a printed piece from a hand-painted one before you buy.
